announcement.quote: Announces Financial Results For Second Quarter Ended 2024, Declares Third Quarter 2024 Dividends of $0.47 Per Common Share and Announces Merger Agreement with Carlyle Secured Lending III

outcome_evidence.quote: On March 27, 2025, the Company was merged with and into Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc. (“CGBD”).

deals.notes: CGBD (NASDAQ: CGBD) is the surviving fund; CSL III shows no exchange or ticker in the excerpts, so listing of the target is not settled. Shareholder approval announced 2025-03-28 filing (0001193125-25-065938); later 8-K (0001544206-25-000069) also refers to the completion of the CSL III Merger effective March 27, 2025.
